paper.title: Integrated Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Layout Design and Turbine Opportunistic Condition-Based Maintenance
paper.authors: Sanling Song and Qing Li and Frank A. Felder and Honggang Wang and David W. Coit

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: target paper and official predecessor inspected; no target code, data archive, random states or raw result archive found
public_asset_candidate_evidence.predecessor_relationship: same GA-pattern-search lineage but distinct 132-candidate problem

paper_source_conflicts: The target states 342 candidates but Section 3.5 prints M=232, equal to the reported optimized turbine count.
The target states 100 m candidate spacing in Section 3.1 but 400 m in Section 5.1.
Section 5.2 says four clusters but Figure 8's caption says two clusters.
Figure 7 calls the continuous layout Stage 2 while the method text and Table 3 identify it as Part 2 of Stage 1.
missing_information: target implementation, exact field mask and coordinates, 2014 wind data, prices, outages, raw layouts, traces, random states and repeats
GA population and operators, target pattern-search settings and k-means initialization
component degradation distributions, thresholds, inspection and downtime costs, weather-delay rule and Monte Carlo replication count
completion_decisions: Use 342 decision bits on a declared irregular 100 m lattice mask within the stated 3 km by 1.5 km site.
Retain the paper's 232 as a reported target result, not a forced solution cardinality.
Use the public predecessor's 50 GA generations and 200 pattern iterations; declare every remaining GA and poll operator.
Sample the two Weibull dayparts and lognormal direction with 40 counter-keyed scenarios and implement the published Jensen/power/capital equations.
Implement four-cluster primary and two-cluster conflict profiles.
Use explicitly versioned component lives, thresholds, high-wind inspection delay and missing economics without calibration to paper results.
Use one persistent all-core executor for population, pattern-poll and maintenance work with one/all-core scientific identity.
Run all twelve native roles and 25 platform seeds after immutable Waffle H6 admission.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reconstruction of target coupled problem method sequence and all twelve native roles; not author code unavailable arrays or numerical replay

decision_variables.resolution: 342 binary occupancy variables then continuous x-y coordinates and one positive inspection interval

encoding_and_decoder.authority: target binary K vector and declared GA completion
encoding_and_decoder.resolution: one bit per candidate; selected points decode in stable site order

constraints_and_repair.authority: target Eq. 19 and internally consistent 100 m text
constraints_and_repair.resolution: site bounds, unique candidates and at least 100 m pair distance; infeasible continuous polls are rejected

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize pre-maintenance revenue minus capital, then minimize maintenance cost and report integrated profit

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen RSS wake, cubic power, capital economy of scale, revenue completion and event-driven opportunistic maintenance

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: twenty samples from each Weibull daypart, lognormal direction and coastward linear speed loss

paper_native_cases.authority: target Tables 3 and 5 plus cluster conflict
paper_native_cases.resolution: two layout roles and two layouts by five inspection intervals; four-cluster primary and two-cluster conflict profile

initialization.resolution: counter-keyed variable-density binary population including one eastern 232-turbine feasible seed

parameters.authority: target equations/tables, public predecessor and declared contract
parameters.resolution: all published physical/wind/cost values plus versioned optimizer, degradation and economics completions

update_order.authority: target two-stage framework and declared deterministic completion
update_order.resolution: binary GA, continuous pattern poll, k-means, interval Monte Carlo, ordered role reporting

stopping_and_physical_fes.authority: public predecessor figures plus platform work contract
stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 100 by 50 GA, 200 rotating-block pattern iterations, 1000 replications per layout-interval role

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: twelve roles, layouts, clusters, energy/revenue/capital/maintenance components, physical work, timings, workers and hash; 25 seeds

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: GA, pattern search, k-means and Monte Carlo maintenance have no learned model
